pixel_description: Side photorealistic view on loose soil with standing person scale on right and gray bin on ground. Twin Tube Chassis: two longitudinal silver tubes between wheels, with cross members. Rigid Grouser Wheels: 2 visible dark lugged wheels (4 implied) under chassis touching ground, with vertical uprights to chassis. Narrow Kerf Chain: vertical toothed chain in soil slot at front-left under ladder toe, plus diagonal chain link to chassis. Inclined Bucket Ladder - critical part: ~8 open steel buckets full of soil in single file along straight inclined frame ~45-50deg to ground, bottom bucket in soil at left, successive buckets up-right to top sprocket gear with short angled spout; frame bolted at lower end to chassis front and mid-supported by A-frame strut to chassis; top end free in air left/above hopper pouring falling soil stream down-right. Steep Wedge Hopper: trapezoidal smooth steel bin mid-right on chassis pivot brackets with bolts and spring, heaped with soil mound above rim. Tilt Screw Discharge: short ribbed screw cylinder on hopper right side pouring dense soil stream into separate plastic bin. Lithium pack: silver box between tubes. Onboard cameras: 3 small cameras on thin black poles mounted on chassis. Contacts: ladder-to-chassis via mounts/strut touch, hopper-to-chassis via pivots touch, screw-to-hopper touch, cameras-to-chassis via poles touch, wheels-to-ground touch. Ladder-to-hopper has no metal chute, only air + falling soil. Bin not touching machine. Callouts: 7 text boxes with leaders.

deviations.measured: found 2, 1.7x wheel, reported apart from ladder/hopper
deviations.expected: 1 chassis, ~4.7x wheel diameter, touching ladder and hopper
deviations.why: Pixels show 1 twin-tube frame with 2 longitudinal tubes counted as 2. Front mount + mid A-strut visibly bolt ladder to chassis and rear pivot brackets visibly bolt hopper to chassis, so apart is segmenter error. Length vs person (~0.5x 1700mm ~850mm) and vs wheel (~200mm) is ~4x, close to 4.7x; 1.7x is coarse mis-measure. Does not change carry/alignment.

Pixels in side view show only fixed vertical uprights above wheels, no sideways folding extension. Folding for 0.45m stow to 0.68m track cannot be verified side-on and may be occluded, but no distinct arm part is drawn. Matters because stow/box and track load path is unverifiable.

deviations.expected: 1 narrow kerf chain, horizontal long axis
deviations.why: Pixels show vertical chain in soil slot at front-left under ladder toe, correctly entering ground for 100mm wide 50mm deep slot, plus diagonal ladder chain. Horizontal expectation is wrong for a trencher; tilt is perspective of vertical digger. Loosening function intact.

deviations.measured: tilted ~49 deg from vertical (i.e. ~40deg to ground), reported apart from hopper/chassis
deviations.expected: 1 inclined ladder, vertical long axis, touching hopper and chassis
deviations.why: Pixels show inclined frame at ~45-50deg with ~8 buckets in line, bottom in soil, top sprocket + short spout free in air left/above hopper pouring open-air stream. Incline is correct per inclined ladder, not vertical, so axis expectation wrong. Apart from chassis is wrong - bolted front + strut touch. Apart from hopper is true and matters - no chute, breaks kerf->ladder->hopper load path.

Pixels show large steel wedge on rear chassis on pivot brackets (touching chassis, so apart is wrong). Large vs screw diameter is correct - 150-450mm hopper vs 150mm outlet screw; 23x is diameter vs width confusion. Apart from ladder is true - gap with no chute - matters for transfer. Over-heaped soil exceeds 20L/15kg but still contains.

Pixels show single ribbed screw discharge on hopper right side pouring to bin. 23 count is soil clods/chain teeth mis-counted. Small diameter vs large hopper width is correct for metered outlet; 1.2x expectation mixes length vs diameter. Metering function intact.

Pixels show silver rectangular pack between twin tubes spanning ~60% chassis length. Qty 2 may be stacked/hidden in side view, one visible. Appears slightly long but still stores energy for dig/drive; does not break power path.

Pixels show 3 cameras on black poles (front short, middle, rear tall) bolted to chassis, matching text qty 3, so 2 expected is wrong. Poles visibly touch chassis, so apart is segmenter error. Blind operation via downward dig camera intact.

deviations.measured: located parts span ~3255mm x 1976mm scaled by ~1700mm person
deviations.why: Pixels vs person: chassis ~0.5x person ~850mm correct for 900-1050mm, wheels ~200mm correct, ladder top ~head height ~1700mm plausible deployed height. 3255mm span includes external soil piles + separate bin gap + ladder overhang, not stowed box. Stowed folding not shown deployed. No box limit broken.

s1_differences: Camera callout misplaced to ladder sprocket; ladder top not over hopper, no gravity chute, open-air transfer only; folding wheel arms not drawn as distinct parts. Chassis, wheels, kerf, ladder buckets, hopper, screw, battery, 3 cameras otherwise present with correct kinds and blind dig-to-bin flow attempted.
s2_feedback: No separate design flaw judged: hopper sits on visible pivot brackets and screw is attached to hopper, ladder is strut-supported, so load paths are plausible. Ladder-hopper air gap and missing arms are drawing faults in this unfaithful render, not proof of design interference or tip failure.
notes: Photorealistic side view, not diagram. No numbers/scale bars. Bin on ground separate is use context, correctly separate. Second battery may be occluded.
